title: Project IGI Mission 1: Trainyard — soldier models skinned in the rest pose (real skeletons, no fudged scale)
source: common/anims/*.iff + missions/location0/level1/objects.qvm + models/level1.res + data/level1_models.json (draw groups/UVs copied verbatim)
units: metres (IGI space, Z up / body long axis; rest pose is a T-pose: arms span X, chest faces +/-Y, head +Z, feet -Z; height = Z span). Engine units / 4096; no scale applied beyond the 1/4096 unit conversion and each vertex's own skin weight.

mapping_evidence.player_note: HumanPlayer has no Bone Heirachy param; the player model is 000_01_1, skinned here with 000.iff on the 4-of-5 guard majority. The one dissenting 000_01_1 guard (task 4023, team 0, BH=1, stand=61) skins 2.5 cm shorter under 001.iff (1.824 m vs 1.849 m).
mapping_evidence.note: BOSH skeleton id == anim filename number for all 6 sets. 001/002/003 share the same parent list; their rest translations differ slightly (bone Z spans 1.864/1.864/1.864 m for 001/002/003 vs 1.890 m for 000 and 1.784 m for 006), so the BH vote, not bone count, is what distinguishes them — every soldier model's HighestSkinBone is 31, fitting any 33-bone set.
